questions.text: need the warranty info 4 the unit @ 1358 n dobson rd

oracle.sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN (e.data#>>'{warranty,expires}') IS NULL OR (e.data#>>'{warranty,expires}') !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN 'unknown' WHEN substr(e.data#>>'{warranty,expires}',1,10)::date < $2::date THEN 'expired' WHEN substr(e.data#>>'{warranty,expires}',1,10)::date - $2::date <= 365 THEN 'expiring' ELSE 'active' END) AS v FROM entities e JOIN entities c ON c.id = e.customer_id WHERE e.entity_type='equipment' AND e.merged_into IS NULL AND c.data->>'customer_name' ILIKE $1
